result.text:
I took a conference talk from Dennis (@voxagonlabs), transcribed it, told fable to make the same tools that he spoke about, and then we drove down the time per frame aggressively.

Big credits to both Dennis & Erin for teaching how this stuff works. 80% of the perf ideas were fable porting what Erin did.

I corrected fable's wrongs a lot of the time, but not because I knew it was wrong -- instead, I was skeptical and told it to check using profiling tools

Music in the video is from Cynthoni's newest album, check it out on bandcamp
